verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships a dedicated `writing-skills` meta-skill that guides the agent through authoring new skills as TDD for process documentation (docs-76). Its cycle is: write pressure-scenario tests, watch them fail, write the skill, watch them pass, then refactor to close loopholes, which covers both writing and improving (docs-15, docs-62, docs-50). An eval harness that judges skill compliance backs this up (docs-14), and the skill references cross-runtime skill directories such as `~/.agents/skills/` (docs-31). missing for 10: explicit packaging/distribution guidance beyond skill directory locations, independent or hands-on corroboration of the writing-skills workflow.
